BiblicalUsage: Machtah is the censer, the pan for live coals, and it stands at the centre of both true worship and rebellion. Leviticus 10:1 has Nadab and Abihu taking their censers and offering strange fire, and Numbers 16:38 has the censers of the rebels beaten into broad plates for the altar, while Numbers 16:46 has Aaron taking a censer to make atonement when the plague had begun.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same pan tells both stories: fire offered wrongly kills, and fire carried rightly makes atonement.
